text: Wrote the spec and split it into one deliverable.
log: product: spec at docs/specs/report-list-json.md — one deliverable, `report list --json`.

deliverables.title: `report list --json`
deliverables.description: Add a --json flag to `report list` in cli/report.py. It prints one JSON array of the rows the table shows, and an empty array when there are none. Acceptance: `report list --json | jq length` works on an empty database and on a populated one.
